body:
This was a fun experience up until I got in trouble, I do plan on doing valium again but not for a while.
About 3 weeks ago I was looking through some old boxes and I found a bottle of pills prescribed to my Dad, it said 'Diazepam (Valium) 10mg tablets, being interested in diazapem before hand I decided I would give it a shot. The next morning I awoke for school and stuck the pills in my pocket at about 10:45 during my break until 4th period started I went to the bathroom where I met up with 3 of my friends, they each took 1 tablet, I on the other hand took 3. After my 4th period I was tripping pretty hard, but for some reason I had forgotten how many I had already taken and took 1 more, we went to lunch they were all still pretty high I was very very high but in a good way, I bought a soda and the princapal walked up to me and said 'is this your lunch?' (my school has 3 different lunches so he thought I was sluffing.) I said 'Yes.' but it took me a second to respond, the valium was slowing me down but I wasn't tired or anything, I went through lunch and then during my 5th period a school cop pulled me out of class, while walking to the office with him I saw another friend and tossed the bottle of pills to him and mumbled 'get rid of them.' he shook his head and walked away, the cop luckily didn't see me throw anything or didn't catch what I had said, when I got to the office I was questioned 'what did you take.' many times I kept saying 'Nothing, I'm fine what makes you think  I took something'.
Then I saw my friends in the office that had taken the valium with me and they had admitted to taking it and said where they had gotten it, except for my one friend Dan who wouldn't say anything (great friend, we go way back) they said they were going to take me to get a blood drug test I said 'I took valium, 3.. Err 4 of them.' and Dan said 'I took 1.' the cop called my parents my parents showed up and they were pissed but sad at the same time Dan's Mom was crying and kept telling me I was better than this (she's like a 2nd Mom to me.) the cop arrested me and took me to Juvenile Detention Center where I stayed for 14 days, and now I face a 3rd Degree Felony in court next week for distribution on a drug free zone, I'm getting it lowered to a mistimeter class B, which is good and I turn 18 in about 7 months, they said if I don't do anything wrong then it will be erased from my Juvenile record.
All in all it was a great high but I just didn't use my brain when I put the pills in my pocket I should've just taken them at home and gone to school.
